Paste a song written with the chords on their own line above the lyrics, the
way most chord websites show it. The compressor puts each chord in square
brackets in front of the word it was over, as in `[G] Abigail`. The result
takes half the lines and usually fits on one printed page.

```{=html}
<div class="tool">
  <label for="compress-input" class="form-label">Chords above lyrics</label>
  <textarea id="compress-input" class="form-control font-monospace" rows="16" spellcheck="false">E
I'm scratching at the surface now

C#m
And I'm trying hard to work it out

E
So much has gone misunderstood

C#m
This mystery only leads to doubt

F#m
And I didn't understand

Abm                                 Am
When you reached out to take my hand

Abm                          F#m
And if you have something to say

B
You'd better say it now

E                         Abm
Cause this is what you've waited for
C#m                        A
Your chance to even up the score
E                Abm           C#m
And as these shadows fall on me now
A
I will somehow

E                              Abm
Cause I'm picking up a message Lord
C#m                               A
And I'm closer than I've ever been before

E                          B                  A
So if you have something to say Say it to me now
B              A
Say it to me now
B              A
Say it to me now
</textarea>
  <div class="tool-actions">
    <button id="compress-button" type="button" class="btn btn-primary">Compress</button>
    <div class="form-check form-switch">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" role="switch" id="compress-as-file">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="compress-as-file">As a new song file</label>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="compress-file-fields" class="tool-fields" hidden>
    <input id="compress-title" class="form-control" placeholder="Title">
    <input id="compress-artist" class="form-control" placeholder="Artist">
  </div>
  <label for="compress-output" class="form-label">Inline chords</label>
  <textarea id="compress-output" class="form-control font-monospace" rows="16" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
  <div class="tool-actions">
    <button id="compress-copy" type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm">Copy</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

With **As a new song file** on, the output is a complete song file: save it in
the `songs/` folder as `title-of-song.qmd` and it appears on the site. See
`_templates/song.qmd` for the other fields a song can have.
